findings.issue: Testing section mandates real Postgres/Redis via Testcontainers and forbids mocking the DB layer, while General guidance says to prefer mocking the database layer in tests. An agent cannot follow both.
findings.recommendation: Delete the mocking line from General guidance; keep the Testcontainers rule as the only DB-testing instruction.

findings.issue: "Write clean, maintainable code and follow industry best practices" gives no executable criterion.
findings.recommendation: Remove it or replace with a concrete, checkable rule.

findings.issue: "Organize modules logically and use meaningful names" doesn't say what "logically" means for this codebase; an agent must guess the module layout.
findings.recommendation: Replace with the actual convention, e.g. feature-based folders under src/<feature>/{controller,service,repository}.ts.

findings.issue: The entire section restates seven rules already given verbatim in Architecture, Database, Logging, API design and Security, adding no new instruction.
No git workflow or build/lint/CI commands appear anywhere, despite this being a coding-conventions stack an agent will use to commit and ship changes.
findings.recommendation: Add a section naming the branch/commit convention and the actual build, lint and test commands.

findings.issue: Security section covers authn/authz but says nothing about request payload validation.
findings.recommendation: Add a line naming the validation approach, e.g. validate request bodies with zod schemas at the controller boundary.
